description: Compares one indicator across 2 to 8 countries (e.g. « unemployment in France vs Germany », « debt of Italy, Spain and Greece ») from ONE harmonised source (Eurostat, OECD, IMF, ILO, BIS or World Bank), so values are comparable. Countries the source does not cover are listed apart. Last 10 years by default.

language.description: Language of names and period labels (default en).

name: compare_countries
title: Compare countries
